explication: feroxbuster is a Rust forced-browsing tool: users provide targets and a wordlist, then it probes paths, reports accessible resources, and can recursively discover links. The map preserves configuration, request/scan management, response analysis, filtering, extraction, terminal handlers, and statistics. Some core files are indexed but not excerpted; their components are included, while uncertain runtime connections are omitted rather than inferred.
